name: tileflow-sdk
description: Public SDK packages and CLI for Tileflow.

scripts.capture:streets: pnpm run streets:prepare && node packages/cli/dist/index.js capture --all --config examples/tileflow-streets/tileflow.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run test:release && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run verify && pnpm run test:baselines
scripts.dev:streets: pnpm run streets:prepare && node packages/cli/dist/index.js dev --config examples/tileflow-streets/tileflow.config.ts
scripts.test:release: node --test scripts/compare-package-tarballs.test.mjs scripts/publication-decision.test.mjs scripts/reconcile-release.test.mjs scripts/release-config.test.mjs scripts/release-workflow.test.mjs scripts/run-command.test.mjs scripts/select-release-tarballs.test.mjs
scripts.visual:streets: pnpm run streets:prepare && node packages/cli/dist/index.js visual diff madrid-overview madrid-center madrid-sol-close madrid-neighborhood madrid-close-street madrid-motorway madrid-airport madrid-transit madrid-tunnels madrid-rural-edge barcelona-waterfront madrid-mobile --config examples/tileflow-streets/tileflow.config.ts --baseline-dir examples/tileflow-streets/test/visual-baselines
scripts.visual:streets:update: pnpm run streets:prepare && node packages/cli/dist/index.js visual update madrid-overview madrid-center madrid-sol-close madrid-neighborhood madrid-close-street madrid-motorway madrid-airport madrid-transit madrid-tunnels madrid-rural-edge barcelona-waterfront madrid-mobile --config examples/tileflow-streets/tileflow.config.ts --baseline-dir examples/tileflow-streets/test/visual-baselines
scripts.publish:alpha:dry-run: pnpm run release:verify-source && pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run check && pnpm run smoke:capture-public
